content_sections.heading: Cochin Port Authority Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. A9/AS. Gr.I(OL)/2026-S gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Cochin Port Authority notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Hindi with English as subject at the Degree level or Master's Degree in English with Hindi as a subject at the Degree level Experience: Absorption/deputation from the grades in Column 12 of the Recruitment Rule: Hindi Translators with 5 years experience. Recruitment Rule also prescribes five years experience of terminological work in Hindi and translation work from English to Hindi and vice versa, preferably of technical and scientific literature, with at least 2 years in a supervisory position. Age limit: Age limit not applicable for absorption/deputation as per the Recruitment Rule (upper age limit of 30 years is for direct recruitment) Other conditions: Open to eligible and willing officers satisfying the Recruitment Rule, by absorption/deputation from grades in Column 12 Column 12 grade: Hindi Translators with 5 years experience Mode of appointment (absorption or deputation) must be ticked in the form Desirable: Knowledge of the official Language Act and Rules framed there under Administrative Experience Experience in organising Hindi Classes or Workshop for noting and drafting Post Graduate Diploma in Translation Knowledge of Malayalam

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date are not considered Applications without ACRs/APARs or other requisite documents, or otherwise incomplete, are not considered Advance copy candidature not considered if the proper-channel application does not arrive within 15 days of the last date

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of probation: 2 years as per the Recruitment Rule Applicant must give an undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected

rows.event: Last Date of Receipt of Application

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (No Report Certificate for missing periods) Attested copies of certificates of academic qualification No objection certificate of the respective Port Vigilance and Administrative clearance of the concerned Port in Annexure-III Certificate of Head of Office as per Annexure-IV

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the proforma at Annexure-II. Attach the documents listed in the circular, including Annexure-III vigilance clearance and Annexure-IV Head of Office certificate. Forward the application through proper channel to the Secretary, Cochin Port Authority. Application must reach on or before 04.01.2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt, 04.01.2027 Only applications received through proper channel will be entertained Veracity of University Certificates and recognition of the essential qualification must be ensured and certified Forwarding authority may send disciplinary case papers if any penalty was imposed in the last 10 years

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Asst. Secretary Gr. I (Official Language).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Cochin Port Authority Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II of the circular; circular and annexures also on www.cochinport.gov.in) and send it to Cochin Port Authority, Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala, by through proper channel, to reach by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.50000-160000 (Pre-revised Rs. 9100-15100), Class-I.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Hindi with English as subject at the Degree level or Master's Degree in English with Hindi as a subject at the Degree level; by absorption/deputation from the grades in Column 12 of the Recruitment Rule (Hindi Translators with 5 years experience).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible and willing officers satisfying the Recruitment Rule, by absorption/deputation from grades in Column 12. Column 12 grade: Hindi Translators with 5 years experience. Mode of appointment (absorption or deputation) must be ticked in the form.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the last date are not considered. Applications without ACRs/APARs or other requisite documents, or otherwise incomplete, are not considered. Advance copy candidature not considered if the proper-channel application does not arrive within 15 days of the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of probation: 2 years as per the Recruitment Rule. Applicant must give an undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cochin Port Authority, General Administration Department.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (No Report Certificate for missing periods); Attested copies of certificates of academic qualification; No objection certificate of the respective Port; Vigilance and Administrative clearance of the concerned Port in Annexure-III; Certificate of Head of Office as per Annexure-IV.
